Graduate School-Newark 2022-2024 Admission Procedures
Procedures
Students should apply online at http://gradstudy.rutgers.edu. A complete application generally consists of the online application, three letters of recommendation, an application fee, official transcripts of previous academic work, a personal statement, and test scores. Please review the applications online, as some programs have additional requirements. Any supplemental materials sent via regular mail should go directly to the Office of Graduate and Professional Admissions, Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey, 35 Warren St, Newark, NJ 07102-1896.
